newsitem.title: USA: Guilford files for 3.25 mln shares.
newsitem.headline: Guilford files for 3.25 mln shares.

text.p: Guilford Pharmaceuticals Inc filed Friday with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up 3,250,000 common shares.

The company has granted the underwriters a 30-day over-allotment option to purchase up to 487,500 additional common shares. The offering will be made through Oppenheimer & Co, Alex. Brown & Sons Inc and Hambrecht & Quist.
After the offering, outstanding shares will total 17,979,490 common, the filing said.
Net proceeds will be used for further clinical development of Dopascan, reasearch, expansion of the company's drug delivery business and working capital, among other uses.

Guilford, based in Baltimore, Md., is a biopharmaceutical company engaged in the development and commercialization of novel products in targeted and controlled drug delivery systems and therapeutic and diagnostic products.
